language.label: Language
language.switchedNote: Language set manually. It will stay this way on this device.

spawnReason.clock_skew: Your device clock is off. Fix the time and try again.
spawnReason.contended: We could not confirm that collect just now. The drop is still yours — tap it again.
spawnReason.cooldown: Too soon after your last collect.
spawnReason.gps_accuracy_too_low: Your GPS is not accurate enough yet. Wait for the fix to settle.
spawnReason.hunt_budget_exhausted: This hunt has paid out its budget.
spawnReason.hunt_not_started: This hunt has not opened yet.
spawnReason.implausible_speed: You covered too much ground too fast. The attempt was logged for review.
spawnReason.no_verified_position: Waiting for a good GPS fix. Step outside if you can — once we know where you are, rewards appear nearby.
spawnReason.no_walkable_ground: Nothing can drop around here. Head back toward the streets and try again.
spawnReason.out_of_range: You are not close enough yet.
spawnReason.player_daily_cap_reached: You have reached your daily limit.
spawnReason.player_not_active: This account cannot collect right now.
spawnReason.spawn_already_active: There's already one on your radar — go get it.
spawnReason.spawn_bounds_misconfigured: This hunt isn't set up to drop rewards yet.
spawnReason.spawn_cooldown: Just collected one. The next reward appears in a few minutes.
spawnReason.spawn_disabled: This hunt isn't dropping rewards right now.
spawnReason.spawn_not_found: That drop is not on your radar.
spawnReason.stale_verified_position: Your last fix is too old. Keep the app open a moment while we find you again.

gps.denied: Location permission is off. The hunt cannot verify a claim without it — enable it in your browser's site settings, then retry.
gps.timeout: The last fix is stale — your phone has stopped reporting a position. Keep the screen on and retry.
gps.unavailable: Your device could not get a fix. Step outside, away from buildings, and retry.
gps.unsupported: This browser cannot report a location. A hunt needs GPS — try Safari or Chrome over HTTPS.

payout.released: You claimed {amount} MON 🎉 — it settles on chain in a moment.
payout.held: You claimed {amount} MON — held for review ({reason}). MON is never sent without a bound being satisfied.
payout.signerMissing: Collecting MON must be signed, and the passkey signer is not wired up in this build.
payout.title: Payout

cota.lede: A Cota is the limit you put on software before it trades for you. You sign the numbers; nothing can exceed them.
cota.noMarkets: Couldn't reach the venue. Try again later.
cota.paperBody: This runs on real Perpl prices with no money. Trading for real needs AUSD, which arrives by bridge from another network.
cota.signIn: Sign in to sign a Cota
cota.signInBody: You need your passkey to sign a Cota — Face ID, fingerprint, or whatever unlocks your phone.
cota.signedBody: Your limit is on file. You can revoke it whenever you want.
cota.title: Sign your Cota

wallet.missingBody: GET /api/me does not exist yet, so this screen has nothing truthful to show. It deliberately shows nothing rather than a zero it cannot vouch for — a balance of “0” you have not earned is worse than no balance at all.
wallet.creditExplainer: Credit is earned from cache finds and shown here once the ledger is exposed. It is denominated in WMON-wei against a {month} WMON Explorer month.
wallet.signedOutBody: Sign in to see your credit. Balances are per wallet.
wallet.progressAria: Progress toward a TURBO Explorer month
wallet.coversMonth: That covers a full TURBO Explorer month.
wallet.percentOfMonth: {percent}% of an Explorer month — {remaining} WMON to go.
wallet.creditNote: Credit is a discount on the TURBO cohort subscription ({month} WMON per Explorer month). It is not withdrawable and cannot be sent anywhere.
wallet.couldNotReadChain: MON · could not read the chain just now
wallet.pendingMon: {amount} MON is earned and on its way. It lands in your wallet within a few minutes.
wallet.payoutsNote: Every settled payout is a transaction on Monad. Tap a receipt to see it on the explorer — you do not have to take this screen’s word for it.
wallet.turboHandleNote: Credit redeems against this builder identity.
wallet.noHandleBody: Credit accrues either way, but it can only be redeemed once a TURBO registry handle is linked to this wallet.

huntList.signInToSee: Sign in to see live hunts.
huntList.missingBody: GET /api/hunts does not exist yet. Open a hunt directly at /hunt/[huntId] — the scope works without this list.
huntList.noneBody: Nothing is live right now. Check back — hunts open and close on a schedule.

hunt.spawnFeedUnreachable: Could not reach the spawn feed.
hunt.claimNotSentBody: The claim could not be sent.
hunt.detailsUnavailableBody: GET /api/hunt/{huntId} is not built yet, so this screen is using the schema defaults: ±{accuracy} m accuracy and a {cooldown}s cooldown. The server still decides every claim.
hunt.unsignedBuild: Claims are unsigned in this build and spawn collection is unavailable — the EIP-712 signer has not been registered yet. The server remains the only thing that decides whether anything pays.

no_find_here.title: No find here
no_find_here.body: The server does not say why, and that is on purpose — a detailed reason would let someone map the caches without walking. Check the readings above: if your accuracy is inside the limit and the band is not burning, you are simply not on it yet.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: Claims are limited to a few per minute. Wait a moment, then try again — nothing was lost.

unknown.title: Claim refused
unknown.body: The server refused this claim in a way this app does not recognise. Nothing was earned and nothing was spent.

claimButton.spawnsOnlyHint: No caches to claim here — walk and rewards drop near you.
claimButton.noFixHint: Waiting for your phone to report a position.
claimButton.needAccuracyHint: Currently ±{current} m — the server refuses a claim on this fix.
claimButton.waitHint: Finds are spaced out on purpose.

band.glossWarm: Something is out here with you.
band.glossHot: Close. Slow down and sweep the ground.
band.glossBurning: You are standing on it. Look down.
band.cachelessGloss: No hidden caches on this hunt. Walk and rewards drop near you.
band.completeGloss: Every cache in this hunt is yours. Spawns still drop.
band.throttled: Reading paused — too many samples. It will resume on its own.
band.waiting: Waiting for a fix and a reading.

find.monthNote: {percent}% of a TURBO Explorer month ({month} WMON). Credit is a discount on the cohort subscription — it is not withdrawable MON.
find.stillHidden: {count, plural, one {# cache still hidden} other {# caches still hidden}}

fix.refusedBody: Your phone is only sure to ±{current} m and this hunt needs ±{needed} m. Step into open sky and wait — the server rejects a claim on this fix, so tapping now only burns a rate limit.

spawnPanel.headerCount: {count, plural, one {# spawn · real MON} other {# spawns · real MON}}
spawnPanel.nothing: Nothing on the scope. Drops appear near you at random and expire fast.
spawnPanel.signerMissing: Collecting MON requires a signature. The passkey signer is not registered in this build.

radar.ariaComplete: Radar scope: every cache in this hunt has been found.
radar.ariaNoReading: Radar scope: no proximity reading yet.
radar.ariaReading: Radar scope: proximity reading {label}. {count, plural, one {# spawn} other {# spawns}} in view.
